tool_definitions.name: describe_screen
tool_definitions.description: Describes the current screen: its fields with their values, its buttons (destructive ones flagged), and its lists with their rows.

tool_definitions.name: list_screens
tool_definitions.description: Lists the id and title of every screen the app can open, whichever screen is current.

tool_definitions.name: open_screen
tool_definitions.description: Opens the screen with the given id, which becomes the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: press_button
tool_definitions.description: Presses the button with the given id on the current screen, after the user's approval if it is destructive, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: select_row
tool_definitions.description: Selects the row with the given key in the list with the given id on the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: set_field
tool_definitions.description: Sets the field with the given id on the current screen to the given value, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: describe_screen
tool_definitions.description: Describes the current screen: its fields with their values, its buttons (destructive ones flagged), and its lists with their rows.

tool_definitions.name: list_screens
tool_definitions.description: Lists the id and title of every screen the app can open, whichever screen is current.

tool_definitions.name: open_screen
tool_definitions.description: Opens the screen with the given id, which becomes the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: press_button
tool_definitions.description: Presses the button with the given id on the current screen, after the user's approval if it is destructive, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: select_row
tool_definitions.description: Selects the row with the given key in the list with the given id on the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: set_field
tool_definitions.description: Sets the field with the given id on the current screen to the given value, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

Perfect! Task completed successfully! Here's what was accomplished:

✅ **Recorded the phone screen arrival**: Added 1 unit of P-02 (Phone screen assembly) to stock through the Parts screen

✅ **Fitted the part**: The phone screen assembly state changed from "on order" to "fitted"

✅ **Updated job status to ready**: Job J-1007 (Sam Rivera's Nimbus 8 phone) is now in "ready" status

The job status flow was: "waiting on parts" → "in repair" → "ready"

The phone screen assembly is now fitted and ready, and the job for Sam Rivera's Nimbus 8 is ready for collection.

tool_definitions.name: describe_screen

tool_definitions.name: list_screens
tool_definitions.description: Lists the id and title of every screen the app can open, whichever screen is current.

tool_definitions.name: open_screen
tool_definitions.description: Opens the screen with the given id, which becomes the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: press_button
tool_definitions.description: Presses the button with the given id on the current screen, after the user's approval if it is destructive, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: select_row
tool_definitions.description: Selects the row with the given key in the list with the given id on the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: set_field
tool_definitions.description: Sets the field with the given id on the current screen to the given value, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: list_screens

tool_definitions.name: open_screen
tool_definitions.description: Opens the screen with the given id, which becomes the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: press_button
tool_definitions.description: Presses the button with the given id on the current screen, after the user's approval if it is destructive, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: select_row
tool_definitions.description: Selects the row with the given key in the list with the given id on the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: set_field
tool_definitions.description: Sets the field with the given id on the current screen to the given value, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: list_screens
tool_definitions.description: Lists the id and title of every screen the app can open, whichever screen is current.

tool_definitions.name: open_screen
tool_definitions.description: Opens the screen with the given id, which becomes the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: press_button
tool_definitions.description: Presses the button with the given id on the current screen, after the user's approval if it is destructive, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: select_row
tool_definitions.description: Selects the row with the given key in the list with the given id on the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.name: set_field
tool_definitions.description: Sets the field with the given id on the current screen to the given value, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

tool_definitions.description: Opens the screen with the given id, which becomes the current screen, and returns the outcome and the current screen.

I see the issue. The system has rejected the status change with the message: "A job that is collected cannot become ready." 

This indicates that job J-1001 is currently in a "collected" status, and the system's business rules don't allow transitioning directly from "collected" to "ready". This makes sense from a workflow perspective - a job that has already been collected by the customer typically cannot go back to "ready" status.

The job status transition may need to follow a specific workflow order. Based on the available status options shown, it appears jobs need to progress through states like: booked in → diagnosing → waiting on parts → in repair → ready → collected → (cannot go back).

**It cannot be done.** Job J-1001 cannot be marked as ready because it already has a status of "collected". The system prevents transitioning a collected job back to ready status, as this would violate the repair workflow logic.
